prompt: The attached image is a 240x294 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden creature</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#fffcf7}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W=240,H=294;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W,H,false);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,1200);
ref.position.set(22,3,500);
ref.lookAt(22,3,0);

const group=(parent,name)=>{
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
};
const creature=group(scene,'Golden pear-shaped creature');
const characters=[creature];
const vec=(x,v,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x-98,150-v,z);
const clamp=THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const u=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)};
const mix=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;

const grain=`
  vec2 pix=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
  float checker=mod(pix.x+pix.y,2.)-.5;
  float weave=mod(pix.x+2.*pix.y,3.)-1.;
  float speck=fract(sin(dot(mod(pix,251.),vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453)-.5;
  gl_FragColor.rgb+=checker*vec3(.047,.032,-.060)+weave*vec3(.019,-.014,.029)+speck*.033;
`;
const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthWrite:false,depthTest:false,
  vertexShader:`varying vec2 p;void main(){p=uv;gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,.99999,1.);}`,
  fragmentShader:`varying vec2 p;
    void main(){
      float y=1.-p.y,x=p.x;
      vec3 ivory=vec3(.999,.990,.982);
      vec3 sky=mix(vec3(.899,.912,.914),vec3(.914,.944,1.),smoothstep(0.,.17,y));
      sky+=vec3(.042,.025,-.010)*exp(-16.*pow(x-.48,2.)-130.*pow(y-.046,2.));
      sky-=vec3(.029,.018,0.)*exp(-2100.*pow(y-.194-.006*sin(8.*x),2.));
      vec3 c=mix(sky,ivory,smoothstep(.176,.254,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(1.,.967,.897),smoothstep(.735,.854,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.663,.658,.653),smoothstep(.816,1.061,y));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      ${grain}
    }`
}));
backdrop.name='Pale sky and distant ground';
backdrop.frustumCulled=false;
backdrop.renderOrder=-100;
scene.add(backdrop);

function finishMaterial(m){
  m.onBeforeCompile=s=>{
    s.fragmentShader=s.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>',
      '#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain);
  };
  return m;
}
const hide=finishMaterial(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.83}));
function solid(hex){
  return finishMaterial(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:hex,roughness:.81}));
}

// Each horizontal section gives the centerline, breadth and front-to-back depth.
const trunk=[
  [17.7,100,0,0,3],[19.5,100.5,8.9,8.1,3.6],
  [23,101.2,15.2,13.9,4.7],[29,101.6,19.1,18,5.5],
  [37,100.8,21.5,20,6.5],[46,99.7,23.4,22.1,7.2],
  [55,98.7,26.1,22.8,5.4],[65,96.8,29.4,24.3,2.9],
  [77,95.6,34.6,27.8,1.4],[92,95.4,37.1,31,1.3],
  [108,96.4,40.1,35.7,2.4],[126,97.4,47,42.4,4.1],
  [146,98.5,54.3,48.2,5.2],[164,98.7,58.2,50,5.8],
  [179,98.4,58,48.9,5.3],[192,98.3,54.5,45.4,4.3],
  [205,98.3,48.3,39.5,3],[216,98,37.5,31.4,1.7],
  [223,97.7,23.5,21.8,.5],[228,97.5,0,0,0]
];
const thighL=[
  [176,69,0,0,-1],[184,70,19,22,-1],[198,73.2,22.6,24.8,-1],
  [217,76.9,20.8,22.4,-1.4],[237,80.4,17.6,19.4,-1.7],
  [260,83.4,14.3,16.3,-1.3],[287,85.7,12.1,14.6,-.7],
  [301,86.6,11.3,14.9,.9],[308,86.1,12,17.1,3.8],[314,86,0,0,4]
];
const thighR=[
  [176,126,0,0,-3],[184,126.8,18,21,-3],[200,124.6,22.9,24,-3],
  [219,118.5,20.6,22,-3.2],[239,115.5,17.5,19.3,-3.2],
  [262,114.8,14.3,16.4,-3],[289,114.7,11.6,14.6,-2.6],
  [302,114.9,11.3,14.9,-1],[308,116,12.3,17,2.8],[314,116,0,0,3]
];
function section(rows,v){
  if(v<rows[0][0]||v>rows[rows.length-1][0])return null;
  let i=0;
  while(i+2<rows.length&&rows[i+1][0]<v)i++;
  const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1],prev=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  const d=b[0]-a[0],t=(v-a[0])/d,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  const res=[];
  for(let k=1;k<=4;k++){
    const ma=(b[k]-prev[k])/(b[0]-prev[0]);
    const mb=(next[k]-a[k])/(next[0]-a[0]);
    res.push((2*t3-3*t2+1)*a[k]+(t3-2*t2+t)*d*ma+(-2*t3+3*t2)*b[k]+(t3-t2)*d*mb);
  }
  return res;
}
function ellipse(x,z,p){
  if(!p)return 120;
  const [cx,r,d,cz]=p,dx=x-cx,dz=z-cz;
  return (Math.hypot(dx/Math.max(.012,r),dz/Math.max(.012,d))-1)*Math.max(.012,Math.min(r,d));
}
function meld(a,b,k){
  const h=Math.max(k-Math.abs(a-b),0)/k;
  return Math.min(a,b)-h*h*k*.25;
}
function front(x,v){
  const [cx,r,d,cz]=section(trunk,v);
  return cz+d*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.01,1-((x-cx)/r)**2));
}
const skinRGB=new THREE.Color();
function bodyColor(x,v,z){
  const rear=smooth(-12,26,z);
  const belly=Math.exp(-((x-100)/55)**2)*Math.exp(-((v-139)/37)**2)*rear;
  const bib=Math.exp(-((x-102)/30)**2)*Math.exp(-((v-106)/23)**2)*rear;
  const muzzle=Math.exp(-((x-102)/22)**2)*Math.exp(-((v-55)/13)**2)*rear;
  const cap=Math.exp(-((v-23)/14)**2);
  const leg=smooth(192,270,v);
  let r=mix(.97,.84,leg),g=mix(.723,.556,leg),b=mix(.148,.172,leg);
  g+=cap*.067-muzzle*.097;
  r=mix(r,1,belly*.9);g=mix(g,.778,belly*.93);b=mix(b,.616,belly*.96);
  r=mix(r,1,bib*.77);g=mix(g,.808,bib*.70);b=mix(b,.648,bib*.67);
  const eyeShadows=(Math.exp(-((x-90)/6.2)**2)+Math.exp(-((x-113)/5.6)**2))
      *Math.exp(-((v-39)/4.5)**2)*rear;
  r-=.12*eyeShadows;g-=.085*eyeShadows;
  return skinRGB.setRGB(clamp(r,0,1),clamp(g,0,1),clamp(b,0,1),THREE.SRGBColorSpace);
}

// Surface nets join the haunches to the torso, keeping the crotch and rump continuous.
function buildBody(){
  const step=1.75,nx=74,ny=174,nz=65;
  const x0=34,v0=14,z0=-53,slice=nx*ny,total=slice*nz;
  const values=new Float32Array(total),ids=new Int32Array(total);ids.fill(-1);
  for(let j=0;j<ny;j++){
    const v=v0+j*step,sections=[trunk,thighL,thighR].map(rows=>section(rows,v));
    for(let k=0;k<nz;k++)for(let i=0;i<nx;i++){
      const x=x0+i*step,z=z0+k*step;
      const a=ellipse(x,z,sections[0]),b=ellipse(x,z,sections[1]),c=ellipse(x,z,sections[2]);
      values[i+j*nx+k*slice]=meld(a,Math.min(b,c),10);
    }
  }
  const pos=[],col=[],ind=[],weights=[],bones=[];
  const off=[0,1,nx,nx+1,slice,slice+1,slice+nx,slice+nx+1];
  const edges=[[0,1],[2,3],[4,5],[6,7],[0,2],[1,3],[4,6],[5,7],[0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]];
  for(let k=0;k<nz-1;k++)for(let j=0;j<ny-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<nx-1;i++){
    const n=i+j*nx+k*slice,inside=values[n]<0;
    if(off.every(o=>(values[n+o]<0)===inside))continue;
    let sx=0,sy=0,sz=0,count=0;
    for(const [a,b] of edges){
      const fa=values[n+off[a]],fb=values[n+off[b]];
      if((fa<0)===(fb<0))continue;
      const u=fa/(fa-fb);
      sx+=mix(a&1,b&1,u);sy+=mix((a>>1)&1,(b>>1)&1,u);sz+=mix(a>>2,b>>2,u);count++;
    }
    const x=x0+(i+sx/count)*step,v=v0+(j+sy/count)*step,z=z0+(k+sz/count)*step;
    ids[n]=pos.length/3;pos.push(x-98,150-v,z);
    const cc=bodyColor(x,v,z);col.push(cc.r,cc.g,cc.b);
    const hw=1-smooth(54,81,v),lw=smooth(187,232,v);
    bones.push(0,1,x<98?2:3,0);weights.push(1-hw-lw,hw,lw,0);
  }
  function quad(n,a,b,reverse){
    const p=ids[n],q=ids[n-a],r=ids[n-a-b],s=ids[n-b];
    if(Math.min(p,q,r,s)<0)return;
    if(reverse)ind.push(p,r,q,p,s,r);else ind.push(p,q,r,p,r,s);
  }
  for(let k=1;k<nz-1;k++)for(let j=1;j<ny-1;j++)for(let i=1;i<nx-1;i++){
    const n=i+j*nx+k*slice,inside=values[n]<0;
    if(inside!==(values[n+1]<0))quad(n,nx,slice,inside);
    if(inside!==(values[n+nx]<0))quad(n,slice,1,inside);
    if(inside!==(values[n+slice]<0))quad(n,1,nx,inside);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  g.setAttribute('skinIndex',new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(bones,4));
  g.setAttribute('skinWeight',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(weights,4));
  g.setIndex(ind);g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
const body=new THREE.SkinnedMesh(buildBody(),hide);
body.name='Continuous golden hide';
creature.add(body);
function joint(parent,name,p){
  const b=new THREE.Bone();b.name=name;b.position.copy(p);parent.add(b);return b;
}
const pelvis=joint(body,'Torso and pelvis',new THREE.Vector3());
const head=joint(pelvis,'Head',vec(99,65,3));
const leftLeg=joint(pelvis,'Leg left',vec(73,199,-1));
const rightLeg=joint(pelvis,'Leg right',vec(124,199,-3));
body.bind(new THREE.Skeleton([pelvis,head,leftLeg,rightLeg]));

function oval(parent,name,center,radii,material,tilt=0){
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,28,18),material);
  mesh.name=name;mesh.position.copy(center);mesh.scale.set(...radii);mesh.rotation.z=tilt;
  parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
function sweep(parent,name,points,radii,material,shade=null,depthRatio=1){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points,false,'centripetal');
  const rings=Math.max(12,(points.length-1)*6),sides=18;
  const positions=[],colors=[],indices=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=rings;i++){
    const u=i/rings,p=path.getPoint(u),t=path.getTangent(u).normalize();
    const a=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(t,new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1)).normalize();
    const b=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(t,a).normalize();
    const f=u*(radii.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(f),radii.length-2);
    const h=f-j;
    const rr=mix(radii[j],radii[j+1],h);
    const color=shade?shade(u):null;
    for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
      const theta=k*2*Math.PI/sides;
      const pt=p.clone().addScaledVector(a,rr*Math.cos(theta)).addScaledVector(b,rr*depthRatio*Math.sin(theta));
      positions.push(pt.x,pt.y,pt.z);
      if(color)colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      if(i<rings){
        const l=i*sides+k,n=i*sides+(k+1)%sides;
        indices.push(l,n,l+sides,n,n+sides,l+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let k=1;k<sides-1;k++){
    indices.push(0,k+1,k,rings*sides,rings*sides+k,rings*sides+k+1);
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  if(shade)geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);mesh.name=name;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
function facePoint(x,v,offset){
  return vec(x,v,front(x,v)+offset).sub(head.position);
}
const eyes=group(head,'Eyes');
for(const [label,x,v,slant] of [['left',90.6,38.5,-.09],['right',113.5,37.8,.12]]){
  const eye=group(eyes,'Eye '+label);
  const lid=oval(eye,'Rounded ochre eyelid',facePoint(x,v,-.78),[4.8,3.1,1.8],solid(0xcda53a),slant);
  lid.rotation.y=(x-100)*.046;
  const coords=[[-3.4,.15],[-1.5,.85],[.7,.91],[2.9,.39]];
  sweep(eye,'Sleepy eye crease',coords.map(([dx,dy])=>facePoint(x+dx,v+dy+slant*dx,.83)),
    [.15,.55,.57,.11],solid(0x8d7529));
}
const mouth=group(head,'Muzzle and mouth');
const lip=oval(mouth,'Soft muzzle',facePoint(103.6,47.2,-1.15),[10.5,4.4,2.55],solid(0xe8af39));
lip.rotation.y=.13;
sweep(mouth,'Quiet smile',[[93,47.9,.32],[96.4,49.3,1.12],[102,49.8,1.28],[108,49.7,1.07],[113,48.65,.5]].map(a=>facePoint(...a)),
  [.12,.83,1.02,.76,.13],solid(0x765621),null,.7);
sweep(mouth,'Lower lip',[[96.2,50.7,.24],[101.1,51.4,.53],[106.5,51.2,.46],[110.4,50.4,.23]].map(a=>facePoint(...a)),
  [.12,.64,.56,.08],solid(0xd99a31));

function gradient(stops,u){
  let i=0;while(i+2<stops.length&&u>stops[i+1][0])i++;
  return new THREE.Color(stops[i][1]).lerp(new THREE.Color(stops[i+1][1]),
    smooth(stops[i][0],stops[i+1][0],u));
}
function buildArm(left){
  const label=left?'left':'right';
  const arm=group(creature,'Arm '+label);
  const values=left?[
    [72.5,67,-1],[65.1,78,1],[58.3,97,4],[53.7,119,4],[48.1,144,5],
    [43.2,164,8],[39.5,180.5,11],[37.2,189.2,13]
  ]:[
    [121.2,67,-2],[128.8,79,0],[135.3,99,1],[140.1,120,1],[145.2,145,1],
    [150.8,167,4],[155.5,185.4,8],[158.8,194.3,10]
  ];
  const pts=values.map(a=>vec(...a));
  arm.position.copy(pts[0]);
  const local=pts.map(p=>p.clone().sub(arm.position));
  const colors=[[0,0xf3bc2d],[.31,0xf6c132],[.57,0xe7b436],[.74,0xb69533],[.9,0x79672e],[1,0x51482d]];
  sweep(arm,'Tapered upper arm and forearm',local,[4,10.1,9.2,6.2,4.55,4,3.8,3.6],hide,u=>gradient(colors,u),1.13);
  const hand=group(arm,'Hand '+label);
  hand.position.copy(local[local.length-1]);
  const sign=left?-1:1;
  const hp=(out,down,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(sign*out,-down,z);
  sweep(hand,'Palm',[hp(-.6,-3,-.6),hp(.35,1.7,0),hp(1.85,6.5,1.1),hp(2.5,11,1.5),hp(2.3,12,1.55)],
    [3.3,4,5.05,4.55,2.7],hide,u=>gradient([[0,0x65572e],[.6,0x51452e],[1,0x48412f]],u),.78);
  const fingerSpec=left?[
    [-2.0,-2.6,21.6,3.3],[.5,.55,25.0,3.9],[3.0,4.8,25.6,3.2],[5.5,8.4,22.7,1.6]
  ]:[
    [-2.0,-2.1,24,3.1],[.5,1.3,26.3,3.5],[3.1,5.5,25.7,2.7],[5.55,8.3,22.3,1.3]
  ];
  fingerSpec.forEach(([start,end,length,z],i)=>{
    const finger=group(hand,'Finger '+(i+1));
    sweep(finger,'Tapered digit',[
      hp(start,9.2,z*.18),hp(mix(start,end,.52),14.2,z*.54),
      hp(end+.45,length-4.1,z),hp(end,length-1.2,z+1.05),hp(end-.35,length,z+1.45)
    ],[1.62,1.8,1.42,.96,.24],hide,u=>gradient([[0,0x4e442d],[.58,0x49422f],[1,0x827355]],u),.92);
  });
  sweep(hand,'Thumb',[hp(-2.2,2.5,1.6),hp(-4,6.8,3),hp(-5.1,12.5,4.1),hp(-5.3,17,5.1),hp(-4.7,18.2,5.9)],
    [2.05,2.12,1.72,1.12,.3],solid(0x625432));
}
buildArm(true);buildArm(false);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff9e9,0xd5aa87,1.58));
function light(name,color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);l.name=name;l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
light('Broad warm daylight',0xfff7de,1.55,-120,215,175);
light('Peach reflected light',0xffdfd2,.61,146,62,95);
light('Soft skylight on back',0xfff0cb,1.03,25,124,-150);

function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref)}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
